title: Story Killers: The Global Disinformation-for-Hire Industry and Team Jorge
summary: Undercover international investigation exposing 'Team Jorge', an Israeli private contractor unit led by Tal Hanan operating AI-driven disinformation software (AIMS). The system commanded thousands of sophisticated fake social media avatars equipped with credit cards and Amazon accounts, manipulating 33 presidential elections globally and executing covert social media smear campaigns.
